title: CAD 26-118342 — Bus vs. Tanker, Hwy 21 at County Road K

fields.callType: MVC / ENTRAPMENT - MULTIPLE VEHICLE, BUS INVOLVED
fields.location: HWY 21 AT COUNTY RD K, LARKFIELD COUNTY WI
fields.zone: FD STA 3 FIRST DUE / LCEMS / SHERIFF

narrative.author: CT2
narrative.text: RP PASSING DRIVER - BUS ON ITS SIDE IN DITCH, HIT FUEL TRUCK. DIESEL EVERYWHERE. PEOPLE SCREAMING IN WINDOWS

narrative.author: CT2
narrative.text: RP ADVS UNK # PTS. RP ADVISED TO STAY BACK, DO NOT APPROACH DIESEL

narrative.author: CT4
narrative.text: 2ND CALLER 555-0162: SMALL SILVER CAR CRUSHED AGAINST TANKER, 2 OCCUPANTS INSIDE

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: E3 TONED OUT PER RUN CARD. E2 ADDED FOR TANKER INVOLVEMENT

narrative.author: CT2
narrative.text: ADDL CALLS X4 SAME INCIDENT - RAIN, LOW VISIBILITY, HEAVY TRAFFIC STOPPED BOTH DIRECTIONS

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: E3 ON SCENE LARK DISP 1. TRI-COUNTY COACH LINES CHARTER BUS ON PASSENGER SIDE AGAINST E DITCH. TANKER LEAKING DIESEL FROM SADDLE TANK APPROX 1 GPM TOWARD STORM DRAIN. 1 PASSENGER CAR INVOLVED

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: E3 EST 28 PTS, MIN 7 TRAPPED IN BUS. E3 ESTABLISHING HIGHWAY 21 COMMAND

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: ** MCI DECLARED - LEVEL 2 - EST 28 PTS ** PER HWY 21 CMD

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: CMD REQ: BATTALION 1, ALL AVAIL ALS UNITS, HAZMAT, STATE PATROL TO CLOSE HWY 21

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: EMS STAGE COLD ZONE COUNTY RD K NORTH OF INTERSECTION. NO EMS ENTRY UNTIL CMD DECLARES SCENE SAFE

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: STATE PATROL NOTIFIED BY PHONE FOR HWY 21 CLOSURE - ETA PENDING

narrative.author: D1
narrative.text: BATTALION 1 (CHIEF Tom Aldrich) ON SCENE

instructorNote: This page opens the MCI. Watch whether DISP repeats the declaration on every channel, assigns LARK CMD 2 and LARK TAC 3, and logs mutual aid ambulance requests with resource, time and ETA. Also check that the Engine 3 to Battalion 1 command transfer gets a briefing, is announced, and has its time entered in CAD, and that the IC keeps EMS in the cold zone and asks for the spill to be reported to the state.
